scope: Private-source capture to Blender to GLB reproducibility check. One gesture, not all catalog correctness.

validation.method: evaluated hand/forearm skin versus torso, head and clothing front surfaces; sampled at 60 Hz

limitations: Hand opening uses source-specific authored corrections; not pure measured mocap.
Face and mouth animation are not transferred.
Not linguistically reviewed; passing geometry checks does not prove correct RSL.
Original public samples remain for the separate video-based understanding exercises; avatar reference players no longer render or request them.
